issues: The card-facing build focus 'AD, Health' is not fully grounded: supplied AD ratios support AD relevance, but the evidence does not establish Health as a build priority. The metadata disclaimer does not supply that support.
The overview's healing wording is acceptable as a general capability summary; passive healing conditions are explained on P.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage.
core_coverage.reason: Directly explains the basic-attack bonus damage and its magic type.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Below 50% health, this passive damage also heals Warwick, with stronger healing below 25% health.
core_coverage.reason: States both supported health thresholds and the shared increase without choosing a disputed multiplier.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick lunges at a target and bites, dealing magic damage based partly on its maximum health and healing from the damage dealt.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the lunge, bite, damage type, maximum-health contribution and healing.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Holding the bite carries him behind the target and can follow its movement.
core_coverage.reason: Explains held repositioning and tracking without claiming exceptionless tracking.

core_coverage.answer_quote: While the bite is active, he is immune to displacement effects such as knockbacks.
core_coverage.reason: States the immunity's scope and active window without extending it to all crowd control.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick senses enemy champions damaged below 50% health by him or allies, follows trails toward them with bonus movement speed that is temporarily lost in champion combat
core_coverage.reason: Explains the marking condition, trails, pursuit speed and combat restriction.

core_coverage.answer_quote: and gains attack speed against low-health targets.
core_coverage.reason: Directly explains the low-health attack-speed benefit.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Both bonuses grow stronger against very wounded enemies.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the shared supported increase without asserting disputed numbers.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Activating Blood Hunt temporarily marks the nearest enemy champion in its area and grants the bonuses against that target regardless of health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains nearest-target selection, area limitation, temporary marking and health-independent bonuses.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick temporarily reduces the damage he takes.
core_coverage.reason: Explains temporary protection without selecting a disputed duration.

core_coverage.answer_quote: When the effect expires or he recasts it, he howls, fearing nearby enemies and making them flee.
core_coverage.reason: Explains expiration and recast triggers, nearby scope and fear behavior.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick leaps in a chosen direction, with more movement speed increasing his range
core_coverage.reason: Explains direction selection and movement-speed range scaling.

core_coverage.answer_quote: He stops on the first enemy champion hit and channels to suppress them, unless their spell shield or crowd-control immunity prevents the channel.
core_coverage.reason: Explains first-target collision, channeled suppression and target protection; counterplay also identifies interruption.

core_coverage.answer_quote: During the channel, he deals magic damage and heals from damage dealt.
core_coverage.reason: Directly explains channel damage type and healing.

core_coverage.answer_quote: he is immune to crowd control during the leap.
core_coverage.reason: Limits the stated immunity to the leap.

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved exact multiplier: retain the supported stronger-healing statement and keep numeric verification in QA metadata.
Unresolved threshold and multiplier: retain the supported general increase and flag exact values for QA.
conflicts.topic: Enhanced Blood Hunt bonuses: Riot says triple below 25%; Wiki says doubled below 25% and elsewhere references 20%

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved maximum duration: retain temporary damage reduction without an exact duration.
conflicts.topic: Primal Howl protection duration: 2.5 versus 2.75 seconds

factual_risks: All six cards remain unapproved; this review supplies neither human approval nor visual verification.
The L1 Health build focus requires supporting evidence or repair.
Passive eligibility for other modified-health units remains pending testing; the general attack wording need not enumerate established unit exceptions.
Held-Q tracking exceptions and tapped-Q cooldown refunds have documented reliability caveats; the draft makes no universal tracking or refund claim.
W detection uses obscured vision, includes decoys and has a Nexus Obelisk exception; these optional details do not invalidate the general draft.
E's R-triggered howl can preserve protection; the draft does not claim every howl ends damage reduction.
R immunity does not generally cover the channel or missed-leap slide. Counterplay correctly specifies interrupting crowd control rather than guaranteeing every crowd-control effect works.
No card-facing provenance, confidence or development labels were found; UNAPPROVED labels remain in metadata.
The supplied evidence is frozen and does not establish current-patch or skin-specific behavior.
